types.name: handle
types.description:
The product category's unique handle. Can be used to create
human-readable URLs.

types.name: is_internal
types.description:
Whether the category is only available and viewable by
admin users.

types.name: is_active
types.description:
Whether the category is active. If disabled, the category
isn't retrieved in the store API routes.

types.name: parent_category_id
types.description: The ID of the parent category.

types.name: rank
types.description: The category's ranking among its sibling categories.

types.name: external_id
types.description: An external identifier for the product category.
